problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 6 delivery routes through 6 distribution centers.

Each route consists of a sequence of handling steps represented as pairs (Center, Duration),
where each pair specifies the distribution center where the handling must occur and the time required.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the handling steps must be performed.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C3, 3) → (C5, 7) → (C2, 10) → (C6, 6) → (C4, 2) → (C1, 7)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C4, 4) → (C2, 8) → (C6, 7) → (C5, 10) → (C1, 2) → (C3, 5)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C3, 4) → (C5, 5) → (C6, 1) → (C4, 10) → (C1, 6) → (C2, 7)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C6, 7) → (C1, 7) → (C5, 7) → (C4, 2) → (C2, 8) → (C3, 10)
* R5 requires the sequence: (C4, 3) → (C2, 10) → (C5, 5) → (C6, 9) → (C3, 2) → (C1, 6)
* R6 requires the sequence: (C3, 5) → (C2, 3) → (C6, 10) → (C5, 6) → (C1, 5) → (C4, 7)

Each handling step must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each distribution center can only handle one route's package at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing order of all handling steps across the centers
so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
